Accurate Destination Search
Avoid the wrong place with the same name

entries.source: শুধু দোকানের নাম নয়, branch দিন
entries.target: Give the branch, not just the shop name

entries.source: যেমন “○○ 新宿店” বা postal address লিখুন।
entries.target: For example, write “○○ 新宿店” or the postal address.
Match the photo and category

entries.source: Restaurant, office, school বা park—map pin-এর category এবং exterior photo দেখুন।
entries.target: Restaurant, office, school or park—look at the map pin's category and exterior photo.

entries.source: Address copy করে message-এর সঙ্গে মিলান
entries.target: Copy the address and match it with the message

entries.source: Interview/training address-এর ward, chōme, building ও floor সব দেখুন।
entries.target: For an interview/training address, check the ward, chōme, building and floor.
Save and label

entries.source: School, Home, Work-এর মতো label দিলে পরেরবার দ্রুত route পাবেন।
entries.target: If you label places like School, Home and Work, you will get the route quickly next time.
Choose Transit from Directions

entries.source: From ও To ঠিক করার নিয়ম
entries.target: Rules for setting From and To correctly
Tap Directions

entries.source: Starting point “Your location” ঠিক আছে কি না দেখুন; বাসা থেকে গেলে home address দিন।
entries.target: Check whether the starting point “Your location” is correct; if going from home, enter your home address.
Select the train icon

entries.source: Public transit route দেখতে train/bus icon ব্যবহার করুন।
entries.target: Use the train/bus icon to see public transit routes.

entries.source: Leave now / Depart at / Arrive by বাছুন
entries.target: Choose Leave now / Depart at / Arrive by

entries.source: Interview হলে “Arrive by” দিয়ে 15–20 মিনিট buffer রাখুন।
entries.target: For an interview, use “Arrive by” and keep a 15–20 minute buffer.
See the Options

entries.source: কম transfer, কম walking, bus/train preference প্রয়োজনমতো দিন।
entries.target: Set fewer transfers, less walking and bus/train preferences as needed.

entries.source: Maps-এর লেখাকে station sign-এর সঙ্গে মিলান
entries.target: Match the text in Maps with the station signs
Read the line name and direction together

entries.source: শুধু platform number নয়; line এবং “for ○○” মিলতে হবে।
entries.target: Not just the platform number; the line and “for ○○” must also match.
The platform in Maps can change

entries.source: Service disruption বা operational change-এ actual departure board-ই চূড়ান্ত।
entries.target: In case of service disruption or operational changes, the actual departure board is final.
Check the train type

entries.source: Maps যে service বলেছে—Local/Rapid—সেটিই ধরুন, অথবা আপনার station stop list যাচাই করুন।
entries.target: Take the service Maps indicated—Local/Rapid—or check your station's stop list.

entries.source: Google নিজেও actual traffic rules/sign confirm করতে বলে। সন্দেহ হলে station staff-কে দেখান।
entries.target: Google itself also advises confirming actual traffic rules/signs. If in doubt, show it to station staff.
From the Station to Your Destination
Exit, compass and Street View
Check the exit number first

entries.source: বড় station-এ ভুল exit নিলে 10–20 মিনিট নষ্ট হতে পারে।
entries.target: At a large station, taking the wrong exit can waste 10–20 minutes.
Look at the blue dot's beam

entries.source: আপনি কোন দিকে মুখ করে আছেন তা beam দেখায়; গোল হয়ে ঘুরলে compass calibrate করুন।
entries.target: The beam shows which way you are facing; if it spins in circles, calibrate the compass.
Recognise the building with Street View

entries.source: Interview-এর আগের দিন entrance, signboard ও nearby landmark দেখে নিন।
entries.target: The day before an interview, check the entrance, signboard and nearby landmarks.
Write the building floor separately

entries.source: Map pin সাধারণত building পর্যন্ত নেয়; floor/room message থেকে দেখুন।
entries.target: The map pin usually takes you only to the building; check the floor/room from the message.
A Real Practice
Rehearsal the night before going to school/work

entries.source: ঠিক address খুলে “Work interview” নামে save করুন।
entries.target: Open the exact address and save it as “Work interview”.
Set Arrive by
If the appointment is at 19:00, set arrival for 18:40.

entries.source: Departure station, line, direction, transfer, platform, exit—প্রতিটি screen রাখুন।
entries.target: Keep every screen: departure station, line, direction, transfer, platform, exit.
See an alternative route

entries.source: Delay হলে দ্বিতীয় route কোনটি তা আগে জানুন।
entries.target: Know in advance which the second route is if there is a delay.
Battery and data ready

entries.source: Power bank, phone charge এবং address text offline রাখুন।
entries.target: Keep a power bank, phone charging and the address text offline.
